login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Use the email address or student username connected to your account.
login.privacy: Your sign-in attempt is security logged. Passwords are never stored in plain text.

errors.invalid: The email, username, or password is incorrect.
errors.suspended: This account is suspended. Contact support for help.
errors.pending: This account is still awaiting activation.
errors.deleted: This account is no longer available.
errors.mfaSetup: Multi-factor authentication must be set up before this account can sign in.
errors.mfaRequired: Multi-factor verification is required for this account.

logout.confirmDescription: You have unsaved work that will be lost if you continue.

signedOut.title: You've been signed out
signedOut.description: Your session has ended. You can log back in whenever you're ready.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: These are the devices currently signed in to your account. If you don't recognize one, revoke it.

feedback.revoked: That device has been logged out.
feedback.revokedAll: You've been logged out on every device, including this one.

errors.notFound: That session could not be found or is not yours.
